previous_versions.body:
I understand the reasons why the US government is advising to fully stop using SMS and I don't disagree. However,

* maybe this is not such a big deal to still rely on SMS for casual applications (?);
* in practice, this is still used a *lot* so I am wondering whether this requirement is really realistic (we can argue that we don't have to care about that).

I have some arguments on this topic but I don't have an opinion.
